screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of intracervical nitroprusside gel assessing patient-reported IUD insertion pain (meets RCT pain-intervention criteria).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled ibuprofen trial with VAS pain at insertion (meets RCT analgesic criteria).
Randomized trial of bladder fullness aimed at ease of insertion; pain measured but intervention is not a pain-control strategy per protocol.
Open-label randomized trial comparing intracervical lidocaine injection vs NSAID with pain outcomes (pain-control intervention).
Double-blind, placebo-controlled ibuprofen RCT measuring pain at tenaculum and insertion (meets criteria).
Double-blind, multicenter RCT of misoprostol vs placebo including insertion pain outcomes (cervical ripening agent within scope).
Randomized, double-blind misoprostol vs placebo in nulliparous women with detailed VAS pain outcomes (meets criteria).
Randomized, double-blind trial of misoprostol for repeat LNG-IUS insertion including pain outcomes (cervical ripening agent; pain assessed).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled ibuprofen RCT in first-time users with VAS pain at insertion (analgesic intervention).
Single-blind RCT of sublingual misoprostol (with diclofenac) vs diclofenac alone; objective includes pain; insertion-related pain assessed.
Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled ibuprofen trial with pain measured at insertion and up to days after (meets criteria).
Randomized, double-blind trial comparing tramadol, naproxen, and placebo with insertion pain VAS as outcome (analgesic RCT).
Double-blind, randomized trial of buccal misoprostol vs placebo in nulliparas with provider ease and patient pain VAS (within scope).
Randomized, double-blind trial of intracervical 2% lidocaine gel vs placebo with multiple time-point pain VAS (local anesthetic RCT).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of vaginal nitroglycerin gel with insertion pain outcomes (pain intervention).
Randomized trial of 1% lidocaine paracervical block vs no anesthetic assessing insertion pain VAS (local anesthetic RCT).
Randomized controlled trial of 2% lidocaine gel vs lubricant/no intervention with insertion pain VAS (local anesthetic RCT).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of intrauterine lidocaine infusion with insertion pain outcomes (local anesthetic RCT).
Randomized controlled trial of sublingual misoprostol vs control in nulliparous women; insertion pain recorded (cervical ripening within scope).
Randomized, double-blind trial of vaginal misoprostol vs placebo in nulligravidas reporting reduced insertion pain (meets criteria).
Randomized aromatherapy (lavender) vs placebo assessing anxiety and insertion pain VAS; aims include pain reduction (nonpharmacologic RCT).
Double-blind, randomized misoprostol vs placebo trial in nulliparas with provider ease and patient pain outcomes (within scope).
Randomized, placebo-controlled phase-II trial of a novel topical lidocaine formulation demonstrating insertion pain relief (local anesthetic RCT).

Prospective single-blind controlled study with paracervical block vs placebo vs no treatment assessing pain at tenaculum and insertion; randomization not explicit but conservative include at title/abstract stage.
Registered randomized clinical trial of misoprostol vs placebo with primary outcome of insertion pain VAS (meets criteria).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of self-administered vaginal lidocaine gel assessing pain at tenaculum placement and IUD insertion (primary outcomes align with protocol).
Technique/opinion piece on intracervical block for IUD insertion; not a randomized controlled trial.
Prospective cohort comparing insertion pain by parity; observational, not an RCT of a pain-reduction intervention.
Qualitative study of non-users’ perceptions of IUDs; no randomized intervention on insertion pain.
Narrative/practical advice review on avoidance of pain; not a randomized controlled trial.
GRADE methodology guideline paper; not related to IUD insertion pain interventions in an RCT.
Committee Opinion on adolescents and LARC; not an RCT of IUD insertion pain reduction.
Review of pain management strategies including RCTs; secondary research, not a primary RCT.
Review on misoprostol in gynecology; not an RCT specifically on IUD insertion pain.
Prospective study of expected vs actual pain with a specific insertion technique; not randomized.
GRADE methodology introduction; not an RCT on IUD insertion pain.
Nonrandomized predictor study of difficult/painful insertion; no randomized intervention to reduce pain.
Evidence-based review on EMB and IUD insertion pain; not a randomized trial.
Systematic review of intrauterine anesthesia across procedures; secondary research, not an RCT.
Observational study on pre-procedure oral analgesia use/anxiety; not randomized.
Technical report on contraception for adolescents; no RCT of IUD insertion pain intervention.
Meta-analysis of RCTs on analgesic options; secondary synthesis, not a primary RCT.
Randomized trial of nitric oxide donors for cervical ripening before first-trimester surgical abortion; not about IUD insertion pain.
Survey of practitioner techniques; not a randomized controlled trial.
Methodology description for a prospective meta-analysis; no primary RCT results on IUD insertion pain.
Commentary/literature review arguing against misoprostol before IUD insertion; not a randomized trial.

Randomized double-blind trial of meptazinol vs placebo for pain following IUD insertion. Although focused on post-insertion cramps, it is an RCT targeting IUD insertion-related pain with a placebo comparator and patient-reported pain outcomes.
Randomized clinical trial (three-arm: lavender aromatherapy, placebo/sesame oil, and control) assessing pain during IUD insertion using VAS; aligns with protocol.
Technique description for simplified paracervical block; no randomized design presented.
Cochrane review of NSAIDs for bleeding/pain with IUD use, including prophylactic trials around insertion; secondary research, not a primary RCT.
